verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs explicitly describe machine-to-machine tokens and API keys distinct from user tokens for agent-to-agent auth (clerk-docs-11), scoped OAuth access limiting third-party data access (clerk-docs-10/29), and an 'eve' feature that gates individual tool calls against the caller's Clerk permissions/scopes, brokering OAuth tokens for agents (clerk-docs-16/27) — directly matching the least-privilege agent credential story. Custom Roles/Permissions further support fine-grained scoping (clerk-docs-4/17). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that scoped M2M tokens work in practice, and more detail on the credential-issuance workflow/API for creating scoped keys.
